description: Interactive Collapsible Org Chart Visual v1.7.8 for Power BI using Deneb & Vega

signals.name: versionId
signals.description: Specification version identifier for tracking in Power BI projects

signals.name: defaultCollapseDepth
signals.description: Initial collapse level: 1 collapses managers at Level 1 and below (shows Level 0 and 1 on load). Set to 2 to show through Level 2, or 99 to expand all.

signals.name: enableStacking
signals.description: Layout mode: true stacks large individual-contributor teams (> gridThreshold reports, no managers among them) into 2 vertical columns connected to their manager by a central spine; false renders the standard tree with all direct reports on one horizontal bus line.

signals.name: gridThreshold
signals.description: Direct report threshold for 2-column stacking: a team stacks only if it has more reports than this AND none of those reports manage anyone (mixed teams stay horizontal so peers never share a row with a colleague's reports).

signals.name: stackMinDepth
signals.description: Minimum hierarchy level depth where multi-column grid stacking is permitted (default: 2 prevents CEO / Level 1 executive team from stacking vertically)

signals.name: showIdInTooltip
signals.description: Show employee ID in the card hover tooltip (default false: IDs can be confidential)

signals.name: downXY
signals.description: Pointer position at mousedown/touchstart to distinguish clicks from drag-pans

signals.name: didPan
signals.description: Tracks whether the pointer dragged since mousedown/touchstart

signals.name: zoomLevel
signals.description: Current canvas zoom factor (0.4 to 1.6)

signals.name: fitZoom
signals.description: Zoom level that fits the whole tree in view (used by the Fit button)
signals.update: length(data('tree_nodes')) > 0 ? clamp((cardWidth / 165) * min((width - 96) / max(1, data('tree_nodes')[0].maxX - data('tree_nodes')[0].minX + cardWidth), (height - topMargin - 64) / max(1, data('tree_nodes')[0].maxY - data('tree_nodes')[0].minY + cardHeight)), 0.4, 1.6) : 1

signals.name: maxExtraLines
signals.description: Most extra info lines used by any card (0-3); drives uniform card height

signals.name: cardWidth
signals.description: Width of each employee card in pixels

signals.name: cardHeight
signals.description: Height of each employee card in pixels

signals.name: nodeSpacingX
signals.description: Horizontal distance between sibling node centers

signals.name: nodeSpacingY
signals.description: Vertical distance between hierarchy level centers (spacious corridor for clean branch routing)

signals.name: topMargin
signals.description: Top margin offset reserving space for the top control bar

signals.name: toolbarOriginX

signals.description: Global flag set to true when Expand All is clicked, false on Collapse All

features: Cursor-Anchored Wheel Zoom, Drag-Anywhere Pan & Double-Click Reset
Unlimited Hierarchy Depth via Vega treeAncestors()
Branch / Division Color Coding with HSL Tinting
Configurable Stacking Mode (Standard Tree vs 2-Column Stacking)
True Reporting-Line Links in Stacked Mode (No Peer-to-Peer Chains)
Leaf-Only Team Stacking with Numeric-Aware Deterministic Ordering
Rounded Orthogonal Connector Elbows (6px Bézier) & Anchor Dots
Live Organization Summary Pill (Headcount & Levels)
Active Reporting Line Hover Highlighting
Approachable Executive CEO Card Styling & ★ CEO Amber Prestige Badge
165×58px Cards & Zoom-Invariant 2-Line Title Wrapping
Unit-Separator ID State (comma-safe expand/collapse & hover lineage)
Stable Branch Colors from Full Lineage (collapse-proof domain)
Zoom-Scaled Toggle & Badge Chrome with Wider Summary Pill
Fallback Root Election (pure-cycle datasets render instead of erroring)
20-Color Branch Palette (no recycling below 20 divisions)
Empty-Dataset Notice (blank data explains itself instead of rendering silently)
Double-Click Card to Center (background double-click still resets the view)
Zoom-to-Fit Toolbar Button (whole tree in view at any size)
Subtle Level Banding (alternating row wash, pan-aware, zero re-layout)
Configurable Tooltip ID (hidden by default for confidentiality)
Optional Extra 1-3 Card Lines (uniform auto-height, documented prerequisites)
